study: Honest early entry, round 2: AGY's two remaining 'get in earlier' arms (fast %R mid-rise, CM RSI-2 oversold turn), fired from completed bars on every board name, against a random later minute of the same name (and, as information, a same-minute other board name).
registered_at: 2026-10-13, after the PRE/IGN study (EARLY_ENTRY_HONEST_2026-10-13.md, FAIL) and before any return from these two rules was computed on market data
origin: AGY 2026-10-13 listed four early-entry arms. PRE and IGN failed the first study. This scores the other two in the same harness, on the same cached bars, with the same control, cost, hold, split and pass bar.
prior: Mid-rise is the desk's 'live' trigger in wr_trigger_study (fast crosses -50, slow rising): matched random minutes on runway. October live mid-rise fills: 42 trades, -4.9 bp. RSI-2: every RSI/MACD event <= a random minute over 60 days (rsi-and-macd-gap-add-nothing); the %R latch + RSI-2 dip FAILED 10/12. The prior is FAIL.

rules.series: signals.compute_percent_r_exhaustion on IEX 1-minute bars (the live feed), extended hours from 04:00 ET for warm-up, cfg = latch_gate_sim.CFG (fast %R(21) EMA 7, slow %R(112) EMA 3). The frame is minute-gridded first exactly as signals._minute_grid_pr does (gaps of 2..MINUTE_GAP_FILL_MAX=15 minutes filled with flat bars at the previous close, volume 0), so row i-1 is minute m-1. Rising = the smoothed line above the previous minute's value by more than rte_direction_eps 0.05, as live _live_percent_r_line (ai_entry_watch.py:11155). CM RSI-2 = signals.compute_cm_rsi_lower (cm_rsi_length 2, RMA) on the same gridded IEX frame.
rules.MID: Bar-close version of live _mid_rise_allows_buy (ai_entry_watch.py:12081): fast[i-1] <= -50 < fast[i] (the cross between consecutive minutes) and slow rising (slow[i] > slow[i-1] + 0.05). No RSI term: live has none (the CM RSI-2 cap ai_watch_arm_cm_rsi_max is admission-only, config.py:1037). Live keeps the cross armed 60 s and fires intra-bar; this fires on the crossing bar only. AGY's version (sim_compare_entry_arms.py:345) also drops slow-rising; that is not scored.
rules.RSI2T: CM RSI-2[i-1] <= 35 and CM RSI-2[i] > CM RSI-2[i-1] (oversold, turning up), with fast %R rising (fast[i] > fast[i-1] + 0.05). AGY's 'rsi2_turn'. Not a live arm. CM RSI-2 is computed on the minute-gridded IEX frame; flat filled bars decay the RMA up and down terms together, so it approximates but is not the live REST-bar value.
rules.SQ: Full square, information only: fast >= -20 and slow >= -20, |fast - slow| <= 15, fast rising (same definition of rising). Onset. Cannot pass or fail the study.
rules.refractory: After an on-board fire, the same rule does not fire again on the same name for 15 minutes. An onset off the board is counted and does not start the refractory.
rules.window: Signal bar start from 09:50 through 15:30 ET inclusive, the same window as the first study.
rules.on_board: The signal minute must be a board minute: at least one ai_reports/decision_ledger row with stage 'watch' or 'arm' for that symbol whose ts falls in that ET minute. A fire off the board is not counted and is not scored.
rules.MIDCAP: Information only: MID with CM RSI-2[i] <= 65, the variant AGY's 10/12 commit described. Cannot pass or fail the study.

fill_and_markout: Entry at the SIP open of the bar starting one minute after the signal bar. Primary exit: SIP close of the bar starting 9 minutes after the entry bar (10-minute hold). The exit bar must start before 16:00, for rules and controls at every hold. A missing entry or exit bar drops the signal (counted). Timing test, not a book replay.
cost: 10 bp round trip, fixed, subtracted from rule and control alike. It cancels in the lift and remains in the net. Gross is printed too.
control: For each scored signal, one random later entry minute of the same name and session: uniformly from entry+1 .. entry+60 minutes, whose entry bar and 10-minute exit bar both exist and whose exit bar starts before 16:00. Held identically. Board membership is NOT required for the control (staying on the board depends on the path). Seed sha256(symbol|day|entry_minute|rule|early-honest-v1). No eligible minute: the signal is dropped and counted. Why later only: a same-hour control can sit on the run-up that made a momentum rule fire. On a driftless synthetic walk (30 days x 15 names), same-hour controls scored PRE -12, IGN -7, SQ -21 bp with |t| 2.3-7.3; later-only controls scored all three within +/-3.5 bp, |t| < 1.4. A residual bias of the later control is the post-fire drift over <= 60 minutes; it is rule-dependent, and bounded by the cross-sectional control (information) and the net > 0 bar.
calibration: Null run on the same synthetic walk (30 days x 15 names), after the cap fix: MID lift +2.5 / +0.2 bp (|t| <= 1.07), RSI2T -0.3 / -1.0 bp (|t| <= 0.68), MIDCAP +3.3 bp half A (t 0.46). tests/test_early_entry_honest.py covers all three flags.
statistic: lift = (rule net) - (control net) per signal. Day-equal mean (mean of per-day means) and day-clustered t. Days with no scored signal are absent.
data: The cached days in ai_reports/early_entry_honest/ built for the first study (26 usable days 2026-09-08..2026-10-13, 0% fetch misses; 2026-09-05 excluded, test symbols only). No refetch.
split: Same as the first study: half A ends 2026-09-24.
pass: Scored separately for MID and RSI2T. Each half is PASS (day-equal lift >= +5 bp, day-clustered t >= 2.0, day-equal net > 0, >= 100 scored signals, >= 6 days with a scored signal), UNDERPOWERED (short of signals or days), or FAIL. A rule is PASS only if both halves PASS; FAIL if either half FAILs; otherwise UNDERPOWERED. UNDERPOWERED is not a pass and is not evidence against the rule. A single-rule pass is reported as 1 of 4 rules graded on these same 26 days across the two studies, out of the 6 arms AGY screened on October data. Signals per half are printed before the table.
information_only: SQ and MIDCAP scored the same way
gross means; 5, 15 and 30 minute markouts with the same control

lead: for each desk fill (outcomes.jsonl, entry_path 'watch', scored days) the minutes from the latest MID / RSI2T / MIDCAP / SQ fire on that name in the prior 15 minutes to the fill; median and share >= 3 min. This tests whether mid-rise / RSI2T fire before the desk's fills
hit rate: share of MID and RSI2T fires followed by a desk fill on the same name within 10 minutes

artifact demo: for random board minutes t whose SIP close rose >= 14 bp over the prior 5 minutes, AGY's shift lift (buy at open of t-5 vs open of t+1, both sold at the 10-minute exit). Shows the shift method's gain on minutes with no rule at all
drop counts: off-board, no entry/exit bar, no control, fetch miss, excluded days
cross-sectional control: lift vs a random other board name at the same signal minute, same entry and hold
every board minute in the window, gross 10-minute markout (the unconditional base rate)
share of later controls whose entry falls inside the rule's 10-minute hold
entry at the SIP close of the entry bar instead of its open (the IEX signal bar is surely published), same control
no_retuning: -50 level, RSI cap 65, oversold 35, eps 0.05, 15-minute refractory, 10-minute hold, 10 bp cost and the window are fixed. Any other value is a new prereg.
if_pass: A pass is provisional: these days were already seen (first study, base rate, SQ) and AGY picked these arms after running them on October data, with no ledger days before 09-05 for an out-of-period rerun. It must repeat on >= 10 forward sessions after 2026-10-13 with the same pass bar (lift >= +5 bp, t >= 2, net > 0) before a result-skeptic review of the positive. It does not change bot_config or the live arms.
if_fail: A FAIL (not UNDERPOWERED) on MID and RSI2T closes AGY's four early-entry arms on this harness. Mid-rise stays off; RSI-2 turn is not built.
script: tools/studies/early_entry_honest.py --study mid_rsi2. --score must not run until this file has a result-skeptic READY. Writes ai_reports/early_entry_honest/result_mid_rsi2.md.
